info.title: Zenedu API v1

post.description: Subscribes a Zapier webhook to an event for the specified bot. When the `trigger` event fires, the platform sends a POST request with the event data to `hookUrl`. This is the subscribe step Zapier calls when a Zap is turned on; keep the returned `id` to remove the subscription later. (Pro)

hookUrl.description: Destination URL that receives a POST request with the event data every time the trigger fires (Zapier's catch hook URL).

trigger.description: The event that triggers a POST with the event data to `hookUrl`.

id.description: ID of the created subscription. Pass it as `hookId` to the DELETE endpoint to unsubscribe.
